summary.text: Gina Oswald is a certified write-in independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine, listed by Spectrum News as living in Strong. No campaign website, statements or Ballotpedia survey were found.

paragraphs.text: Listed as an independent candidate from Strong on the list of declared write-in candidates reported by Spectrum News; Ballotpedia has no biographical information.

sources.title: Maine's U.S. Senate race to include 6 write-in candidates, triggering ranked-choice voting
